leadText:
Choir Tournament (Japanese: VSシキジカ VS ), titled VS Deerling in the Shogakukan Asia translation, is the 534th chapter of the Pokémon Adventures manga, and the 10th chapter of the .

It is subtitled Deerling (Japanese: コーラス・コンペティション Chorus Competition) in the VIZ Media translation and Choir Tournament in the Shogakukan Asia translation.

==Plot==
 

==Major events==
The Trainers' School performs in the Autumn Choir Tournament.
Roxie participates in the competition as a judge, having been requested to by .
Blake and 's team wins the competition, awarding them to participate in another competition in Castelia City.
Roxie has her father take 's class to Castelia City.
Blake reveals to that Bronius and Ryoku were spotted in the Castelia Sewers, and their task is to go and investigate the area.
